Work In Process Tracking System

A prominent company in sanitary wares and faucets industry faced several challenges in their day-to-day operations. These challenges were impeding efficiency, causing financial losses, and impacting customer satisfaction. As the business continued to experience year-over-year growth, the need for heightened efficiency and unwavering quality became the priority to uphold the brand’s reputation, particularly known for its distinctive style and extensive consumer network. Even a marginal increase in production capacity posed a significant risk, as it could potentially result in simultaneous quality lapses and operational errors, both in dispatch and production.

It became abundantly clear that a system was essential to streamline and manage the intricacies of the extensive production, inventory, and dispatch processes. The main objective was not merely to minimize errors in production relative to bookings but also to establish a comprehensive system capable of meticulously tracking and tracing the complete lineage of any product, from its inception to its successful installation. And this what exactly Raj Barcode’s Work in progress tracing system provided them complete tracking and tracing from its inception to successful installation.

Challenges

  • 1. Identifying and Managing Damages on the Shop Floor: The industry struggled to promptly identify and address damages occurring during manufacturing and handling processes.
  • 2.Identifying Training Needs for Manual Processes: The need for manual labor and processes made it challenging to assess and address employee training needs effectively.
  • 3.Managing and Maintaining Inventory in Real-time: Real-time inventory management was a constant struggle, leading to stockouts or overstocking issues.
  • 4.Reducing Damages During Material Handling and Dispatch Errors: Material handling and dispatch errors were resulting in significant product damages and financial losses.
  • 5.Streamlining Product and Accessory Packaging: Packaging processes required optimization to enhance product protection and customer perception.

Results

  • 1.Developed a Module for Lifecycle Traceability: A sophisticated module was developed to trace the complete lifecycle of sanitary wares and faucets, ensuring accountability and transparency at every stage.
  • 2. Implemented Material Identification & Traceability Solution: Barcodes and RFID technology were employed to track materials, making it easier to monitor their movement throughout the production process.
  • 3. Streamlined Production and Improved Quality Control: These changes optimized production processes, reduced errors, and enhanced quality control measures.
  • 4. Optimized Production Cost Calculation: Accurate tracking of materials and processes allowed for precise calculation of production costs, helping the industry minimize expenses.
  • 5. Minimized Damages and Errors: Through improved traceability and handling procedures, damages and errors were significantly reduced.
